SELECT tdm42_manl_org_id AS manl_org_id, tdm42_company_id AS company_id, tdm42_company_nm AS company_name, tdm42_org_nm AS org_name, tdm42_role_nm AS role_name, tdm42_exct_id AS exct_id, tdm42_exct_nm AS exct_name, tdm42_manl_duty_end_yn AS manl_duty_end_yn, TO_CHAR(tdm42_manl_duty_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS manl_duty_end_date, tdm42_task_cnt AS task_cnt, tdm42_task_relate_detail_cnt AS task_relate_detail_cnt, tdm42_task_relate_duty_cnt AS task_relate_duty_cnt, tdm42_manl_cnt AS manl_cnt, TO_CHAR(tdm42_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_date, TO_CHAR(tdm42_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_date, tdm42_start_date_str AS start_date_yn_str, tdm42_appr_status_cd AS appr_status_code, tdm42_appr_status_nm AS appr_status_name, tdm42_job_nm AS job_name, COALESCE(tdm42_lock_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS lock_yn FROM ( SELECT tdm42_manl_org.* , COALESCE(role_nm, tdm20_role_nm) AS tdm42_role_nm , f_emp_kor_nm(tdm42_exct_id) AS tdm42_exct_nm , f_get_company_nm(tdm42_company_id) AS tdm42_company_nm , org00_kor_nm AS tdm42_org_nm , CASE WHEN end_yn THEN end_date ELSE null END AS tdm42_manl_duty_end_date , end_yn AS tdm42_manl_duty_end_yn , task_cnt AS tdm42_task_cnt , task_detail_cnt AS tdm42_task_relate_detail_cnt , task_duty_cnt AS tdm42_task_relate_duty_cnt , task_check_cnt AS tdm42_manl_cnt , COALESCE(apr01_status_cd, '00') AS tdm42_appr_status_cd , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS tdm42_appr_status_nm , tdm40_job_nm AS tdm42_job_nm , org00_sort_order AS org_seq , CASE WHEN tdm42_start_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'true' ELSE NULL END AS tdm42_start_date_str FROM tdm42_manl_org INNER JOIN tdm40_manl_job ON tdm40_manl_job_id = tdm42_manl_job_id LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT tdm43_role_nm role_nm , COUNT(*) task_check_cnt FROM tdm43_manl WHERE tdm43_manl_org_id = tdm42_manl_org_id GROUP BY tdm43_role_nm ) tdm43 ON TRUE INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm42_role_id INNER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN tdm44_end_yn = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN true ELSE false END end_yn , MAX(tdm44_end_date) end_date , COUNT(DISTINCT tdm41_task_id) task_cnt , COUNT(DISTINCT tdm41_task_relate_detail_id) task_detail_cnt , COUNT(DISTINCT tdm41_task_relate_duty_id) task_duty_cnt FROM tdm41_manl_duty INNER JOIN tdm44_manl_duty_org ON tdm44_manl_duty_id = tdm41_manl_duty_id WHERE tdm41_manl_job_id = tdm42_manl_job_id AND tdm41_role_id = tdm42_role_id AND tdm44_org_id = tdm42_org_id ) tdm41 ON TRUE LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = tdm42_appr_id INNER JOIN LATERAL getOrg(tdm42_company_id, COALESCE(tdm42_start_date, f_today())) ON org00_org_id = tdm42_org_id
, ( SELECT f_get_tdmOrg_id2(CAST(#{companyId} AS numeric), CAST(#{orgId} AS numeric), f_today()) tdmOrg_id ) o
WHERE 1=1
AND tdm42_company_id = #{companyId}
AND tdm42_org_id = tdmOrg_id
) t WHERE 1=1 AND COALESCE(tdm42_appr_status_cd, '00') IN ('10','20','30')
AND tdm42_manl_duty_end_date BETWEEN CAST(#{startDate} AS date) AND CAST(#{closeDate} AS date)
AND CONCAT(tdm42_role_nm, tdm42_exct_nm) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY tdm42_company_id, org_seq, tdm42_role_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu", tdm42_start_date

tdm42_appr_status_nm , tdm40_job_nm AS tdm42_job_nm , org00_sort_order AS org_seq , CASE WHEN tdm42_start_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'true' ELSE NULL END AS tdm42_start_date_str FROM tdm42_manl_org INNER JOIN tdm40_manl_job ON tdm40_manl_job_id = tdm42_manl_job_id LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT tdm43_role_nm role_nm , COUNT(*) task_check_cnt FROM tdm43_manl WHERE tdm43_manl_org_id = tdm42_manl_org_id GROUP BY tdm43_role_nm ) tdm43 ON TRUE INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm42_role_id INNER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN tdm44_end_yn = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN true ELSE false END end_yn , MAX(tdm44_end_date) end_date , COUNT(DISTINCT tdm41_task_id) task_cnt , COUNT(DISTINCT tdm41_task_relate_detail_id) task_detail_cnt , COUNT(DISTINCT tdm41_task_relate_duty_id) task_duty_cnt FROM tdm41_manl_duty INNER JOIN tdm44_manl_duty_org ON tdm44_manl_duty_id = tdm41_manl_duty_id WHERE tdm41_manl_job_id = tdm42_manl_job_id AND tdm41_role_id = f_today())) ON org00_org_id = tdm42_org_id
, ( SELECT f_get_tdmOrg_id2(CAST(#{companyId} AS numeric), CAST(#{orgId} AS numeric), f_today()) tdmOrg_id ) o
WHERE 1=1
AND tdm42_company_id = #{companyId}
AND tdm42_org_id = tdmOrg_id
) t WHERE 1=1
AND ( f_today() BETWEEN tdm42_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm42_end_date, TO_DATE('99991231', 'yyyyMMdd')) OR (tdm42_start_date IS NULL AND tdm42_end_date IS NULL) )
AND CONCAT(tdm42_role_nm, tdm42_exct_nm) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY tdm42_company_id, org_seq, tdm42_role_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8", tdm42_start_date
